title: Lineage finding — one column traced as a scoped graph with verbatim evidence

root_id.description: id of the node for the target column itself

nodes.description: One node per column-at-a-definition. Two nodes may share table/column names if they are different states (a temp table rewritten later); scope keeps them apart.

schema.description: empty for CTEs/DataFrames; catalog.schema where qualified

column.description: for literal/runtime nodes: the literal or expression text

scope.description: file / statement / cell / write-version that defines this state, e.g. repo/etl/load.sql:CREATE VOLATILE TABLE vt_sales (2nd write)

terminal.description: expanded: has upstream edges. repo_boundary: read but never written in this repo. literal/runtime: constant or CURRENT_DATE-like. unresolved: dead end.

boundary_reason.description: why tracing stopped here (empty for expanded nodes)

search_notes.description: for repo_boundary: what you searched for and where, to show no producer exists

edges.description: source node → the node it feeds, one hop. dependency_kind separates value inputs from row-selection context.

expression.description: the immediate expression at this hop (or the predicate, for join/filter)

mappings.description: One entry per terminal VALUE source of the target column: the CSV rows. Sources reached only through join/filter/group/window/order/control edges are not mapped here; they are dependencies, not sources.

mapping_rule.description: the full derivation from this source to the target column, composed across hops; row-selection context stated inline (e.g. 'where fx.is_current = 1')

mapping_business_rule.description: one plain-English sentence; no SQL keywords

unresolved.description: one line per dead end: what you looked for, where, and what stopped you

quote.description: verbatim text that occurs within those lines — the harness checks it
